heading: “Plain language” requirement for Federal banking agency rules

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Each Federal banking agency shall use plain language in all proposed and final rulemakings published by the agency in the Federal Register after January 1, 2000.

tree.heading: Report
tree.text: Not later than March 1, 2001, each Federal banking agency shall submit to the Congress a report that describes how the agency has complied with subsection (a).

tree.heading: Definition
tree.text: For purposes of this section, the term “Federal banking agency” has the meaning given that term in section 1813 of this title.

notes.text: Codification Section was enacted as part of the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act, and not as part of title III of Pub. L. 103–322 which comprises this chapter.
